title: Observe selector callback ownership during native UIKit input
admission: Investigate the concrete EXP210 app-level input mismatch using the separately reviewed callback-side design. This is a native acceptance prerequisite, not CI-flake repair. Preserve EXP218 and do not repeat its observer contract.

environment.device_policy: Create one fresh task-owned iPhone17/iOS27.0 simulator only after exact runtime verification. Semantic boot completion required. Remove it and both app containers after pair or stop.

fixed_sequence: Fresh clean installation and unique run identity
Launch UIKit stack with existing default view/action predicates when SDK-on
Assert foreground Home, receipt0 and visible/hittable switch value0 before input
Existing home.tap button.tap() then its original 1.2-second capture window and native receipt1 within15seconds
Record pre-input switch frame/value and perform the existing home.toggle toggle.tap() exactly once
Freeze value transition and callback/receipt outcome within15seconds, before any later interaction
Flush the bounded event buffer at the post-input boundary; capture native records and perform scoped termination/uninstall cleanup
allowed_changes: Fresh isolated copies of baseline SDK and prior fixture; SDK bytes remain unchanged.
Public UIApplication.sendAction override calls super exactly once; bounded value-only entry/exit records with action identity, selector, sender identity/class/AXID and returned Bool.
Add a bounded in-memory callback record immediately before the unchanged native_input write. Keep original target/action, UIAction closure, geometry and one tap per control.
Add monotonic receipt timestamps; keep original15second effect limits and capture window.
New frozen oracle/runner and negative controls; fresh simulator/process/run identity and full source/binary/runtime cleanup guards.
forbidden_changes: SDK code, public APIs, accepted fixtures, repository build scripts or dependencies.
Duo boot or fold tests, physical device work or Session Replay content tests.
Input retry, programmatic control action, successful-only selection, post-result oracle relaxation.
Remote publication, new PR, merge or CI-flake repair.
decisive_oracle: Require exact native receipt/run/input identities, original button positive control and frozen switch state/receipt before flush or later input.
For the selector-based switch: assigned touch begin, one matching sendAction entry, one original callback with that active action identity, matching exit and frozen value0to1/receipt2 in order.
Do not require ended-touch ancestry, callback containment in sendEvent or a value transition inside sendAction. Do not require a sendAction witness for UIButton UIAction.
Successful native callback without matching action evidence is OBSERVER_INCONCLUSIVE, never SDK interference or a qualified witness. Missing native effect is preserved as a diagnostic failure.
Both fixed arms run unless source/environment/build/collector/cleanup integrity fails. Two successes do not resolve earlier intermittency or close release gates.

Reject wrong selector/sender/AXID, duplicate actions/callbacks, missing assigned touch, late callback/action, stale/restored run, buffer loss, source/build/runtime drift and unexpected XCTest inventory.
stop_rules: Terminal semantic boot failure, unexpected crash, timeout or any identity/cleanup failure stops remaining native work. Preserve partials.
No additional pair after inconclusive or passing outcomes. Plan a specific new discriminator only if evidence warrants it.
pause_reason: User requested a safe checkpoint before restarting the laptop.
resume: Preserve this completed preparation attempt. Do not extend/reopen its deadline. Define a separate bounded execution admission after fresh environment discovery and completion/review of the host runner; reuse prepared sources and controls only after hash verification.
